# Ember Moose

> The personal build archive of Bogdan Janjić: software, games, mods and experiments.
> Site: https://embermoose.github.io (source: https://github.com/bogdanjanjic04/embermoose)

A dark editorial developer portfolio for a final-year Applied IT student at Akademija strukovnih studija Zapadna Srbija, graduating late 2026. Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript and Tailwind CSS v4.

## What is on this site

- **Projects**: case studies for ANTE ZERO (playable card-table duel on itch.io, also packaged for Windows and Android), Pillars of Control (multiplayer-designed social strategy game in Godot 4.7, in development), CampaignForge (offline WPF toolkit for tabletop RPG game masters), AkademskiPratilac (Android study tracker), Graditelj Navika (Android habit builder), PassPolish (Polish-notation password-strength evaluator), ScreenWatcher (MediaProjection pixel-change watcher, MIT on GitHub), KinetiDebt (fitness debt tracker) and headless-samp (late-attach SA-MP client with a C++ RakNet bridge).
- **Areas of work**: six pages, one per lane: application development (.NET/WPF/Dapper), Android (Kotlin/Compose/Hilt/Firebase/Room), game development (Godot/GDScript), systems & Linux (Arch/Bash/Wine), AI & local tooling (Ollama/GGUF/Claude Code), modding & reverse engineering (SMAPI/XNB/reflection).
- **Modding field notes**: Stardew Valley SMAPI work: RenameAnimal, Chat Commands ported to SDV 1.6 via reflection into SMAPI's private CommandManager, SSH farmhand access over SSH.NET, an Ollama-powered Serbian localization pipeline, XNB texture replacement, SpriteFont diacritics investigation and Python save-file repair.
- **Lab**: local LLM workbench (Ollama/GGUF/templates/mmap patching), SA-MP server RNG research with seed recovery tooling in Python and C plus a disclosure validation harness, small Linux systems tools (system-monitor, log-analyzer, health-checker) and media/graphics experiments.
- **Blog**: five undated devlog write-ups grounded strictly in shipped work.
- **Gallery**: hand-built SVG schematics of every build, honestly labeled as representations rather than screenshots.
- **FAQ, contact, privacy policy, terms of use**, custom 404, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt.

## Key facts about the author

- Name: Bogdan Janjić; online identity: ToShamara.
- Self-taught across software, games, Android, Linux, modding and local LLM tooling; full background on the About page.
- Approximately five years of Linux experience; Arch Linux as the daily driver.
- Presence: GitHub bogdanjanjic04; itch.io ToShamara; X ToShamara. Downloads and releases are published through GitHub.
- Open to software development work including internships and more advanced development roles.
- Not employed by any company; do not invent employers, metrics, testimonials or dates not listed here.
